question: SKU-018의 최근 7일 일평균 판매량은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty)::numeric / 7 AS avg_daily_qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-018' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-02' AND DATE '2026-11-08'

question: 부산센터 SKU-040의 결품률은 전체 기간 기준으로 얼마야?
goldenSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN on_hand = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS stockout_rate FROM scm.inventory_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-040' AND location_id = 'LOC-02'

question: SKU-046의 예측 정확도는?
goldenSql: WITH w AS (SELECT f.sku, f.location_id, f.week_start, f.forecast_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS actual FROM scm.forecast_weekly f LEFT JOIN scm.sales_daily s ON s.sku = f.sku AND s.location_id = f.location_id AND s.sale_date BETWEEN f.week_start AND f.week_start + 6 WHERE f.sku = 'SKU-046' GROUP BY f.sku, f.location_id, f.week_start, f.forecast_qty) SELECT 1 - SUM(ABS(actual - forecast_qty))::numeric / SUM(actual) AS accuracy FROM w

question: 서울센터에서 안전재고를 밑도는 품목은 몇 개야?
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.supply_policy p ON p.sku = i.sku AND p.location_id = i.location_id WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND i.location_id = 'LOC-01' AND i.on_hand < p.safety_stock

question: 지금 발주가 필요한 SKU-거점을 전부 알려줘
goldenSql: SELECT i.sku FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.supply_policy p ON p.sku = i.sku AND p.location_id = i.location_id WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND i.on_hand + i.in_transit <= p.reorder_point
note: v3 도구 대상(reorder_needed, list). 정답은 sku 컬럼만 본다

question: 음료 카테고리의 최근 28일 일평균 판매량은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(s.qty)::numeric / 28 AS avg_daily_qty FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE p.category = '음료' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08'
note: 카테고리 조건. v3 도구로는 표현 불가, v4에서 넓히려는 범위

question: B등급 품목의 지난달 결품률은?
goldenSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN i.on_hand = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS stockout_rate FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.abc_class = 'B' AND i.snap_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'
note: 등급 조건 + 기간. v4에서 넓히려는 범위

question: 영남권 전체의 재고보유일수는?
goldenSql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(i.on_hand) FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = i.location_id WHERE l.region = '영남권' AND i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08')::numeric / ((SELECT SUM(s.qty) FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = s.location_id WHERE l.region = '영남권' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08')::numeric / 28) AS days_of_supply

question: 냉동식품 카테고리에서 안전재고 미달인 SKU-거점은 몇 개야?
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.supply_policy p ON p.sku = i.sku AND p.location_id = i.location_id JOIN scm.product pr ON pr.sku = i.sku WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND pr.category = '냉동식품' AND i.on_hand < p.safety_stock

question: C등급 품목 중 재주문이 필요한 SKU-거점 수는?
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.supply_policy p ON p.sku = i.sku AND p.location_id = i.location_id JOIN scm.product pr ON pr.sku = i.sku WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND pr.abc_class = 'C' AND i.on_hand + i.in_transit <= p.reorder_point

question: 재고보유일수가 3일 미만인 SKU-거점은 몇 개야?
goldenSql: WITH d AS (SELECT sku, location_id, SUM(qty)::numeric / 28 AS daily FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY sku, location_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN d ON d.sku = i.sku AND d.location_id = i.location_id WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' AND d.daily > 0 AND i.on_hand / d.daily < 3
note: 지표 값에 임계값 조건. v4 도구로도 표현 불가, SQL 경로

question: 최근 7일 판매량이 그 직전 7일보다 줄어든 품목은 몇 개야?
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT sku FROM scm.sales_daily GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-02' AND DATE '2026-11-08') < SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-26' AND DATE '2026-11-01')) t
note: 두 기간 비교. 도구로 표현 불가, SQL 경로

question: 재고보유일수가 가장 긴 품목 3개는?
goldenSql: WITH oh AS (SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand)::numeric AS on_hand FROM scm.inventory_daily WHERE snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY sku), d AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty)::numeric / 28 AS daily FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY sku) SELECT oh.sku FROM oh JOIN d ON d.sku = oh.sku WHERE d.daily > 0 ORDER BY oh.on_hand / d.daily DESC, oh.sku LIMIT 3

question: 서울센터에서 결품률이 높은 품목 2개는?
goldenSql: SELECT sku FROM scm.inventory_daily WHERE location_id = 'LOC-01' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN on_hand = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) DESC, sku LIMIT 2

question: 스낵 카테고리에서 최근 14일 일평균 판매량 상위 3개 품목은?
goldenSql: SELECT s.sku FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE p.category = '스낵' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-26' AND DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY s.sku ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC, s.sku LIMIT 3
note: 카테고리 조건의 순위. v4에서 넓히려는 범위

question: B등급 품목 중 예측 정확도가 가장 낮은 3개는?
goldenSql: WITH w AS (SELECT f.sku, f.location_id, f.week_start, f.forecast_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS actual FROM scm.forecast_weekly f JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = f.sku LEFT JOIN scm.sales_daily s ON s.sku = f.sku AND s.location_id = f.location_id AND s.sale_date BETWEEN f.week_start AND f.week_start + 6 WHERE p.abc_class = 'B' GROUP BY f.sku, f.location_id, f.week_start, f.forecast_qty) SELECT sku FROM w GROUP BY sku ORDER BY 1 - SUM(ABS(actual - forecast_qty))::numeric / SUM(actual) ASC, sku LIMIT 3
note: 등급 조건의 순위. v4에서 넓히려는 범위

question: 카테고리별 현재고 합계를 많은 순으로 보여줘
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(i.on_hand) AS on_hand FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY on_hand DESC, p.category

question: 예측 정확도가 가장 높은 거점은 어디야?
goldenSql: WITH w AS (SELECT f.sku, f.location_id, f.week_start, f.forecast_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS actual FROM scm.forecast_weekly f LEFT JOIN scm.sales_daily s ON s.sku = f.sku AND s.location_id = f.location_id AND s.sale_date BETWEEN f.week_start AND f.week_start + 6  GROUP BY f.sku, f.location_id, f.week_start, f.forecast_qty) SELECT l.name FROM w JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = w.location_id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY 1 - SUM(ABS(actual - forecast_qty))::numeric / SUM(actual) DESC, l.name LIMIT 1
note: 거점 단위 순위. 도구로 표현 불가, SQL 경로

question: 지난주 판매량이 많은 거점 순으로 보여줘
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-26' AND DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY location_id ORDER BY qty DESC, location_id

question: 지난주 SKU-018 판매량 합계는?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-018' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-26' AND DATE '2026-11-01'

question: 최근 7일 수도권 출고량은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = s.location_id WHERE l.region = '수도권' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-02' AND DATE '2026-11-08'

question: 이번 달 생활용품 카테고리 판매량은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE p.category = '생활용품' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-01' AND DATE '2026-11-08'

question: 9/14~9/20 부산센터 판매량은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE location_id = 'LOC-02' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-20'

question: 최근 28일 SKU-029 판매량 합계는?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-029' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-11-08'
note: 합계를 묻는다. 일평균 도구로 보내면 틀린다

question: 어제 가장 많이 팔린 품목은 몇 개 팔렸어?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily WHERE sale_date = DATE '2026-11-07' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 1

question: 전월 대구센터 B등급 품목 출고량은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(s.qty) AS qty FROM scm.sales_daily s JOIN scm.product p ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE p.abc_class = 'B' AND s.location_id = 'LOC-05' AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'

question: 부산센터 SKU-012의 안전재고는 몇 개야?
goldenSql: SELECT safety_stock FROM scm.supply_policy WHERE sku = 'SKU-012' AND location_id = 'LOC-02'
note: 정책 값 조회. 안전재고 미달 도구로 보내면 틀린다

question: 서울센터 SKU-029의 재주문점과 현재고를 알려줘
goldenSql: SELECT p.reorder_point, i.on_hand FROM scm.supply_policy p JOIN scm.inventory_daily i ON i.sku = p.sku AND i.location_id = p.location_id WHERE p.sku = 'SKU-029' AND p.location_id = 'LOC-01' AND i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08'
note: 값 조회. 재주문 필요 도구로 보내면 틀린다

question: SKU-046의 이번 주 예측 수량은?
goldenSql: SELECT SUM(forecast_qty) AS forecast_qty FROM scm.forecast_weekly WHERE sku = 'SKU-046' AND week_start = DATE '2026-11-02'
note: 예측값 조회. 예측 정확도 도구로 보내면 틀린다

question: 리드타임이 가장 긴 SKU-거점의 리드타임은 며칠이야?
goldenSql: SELECT MAX(lead_time_days) AS lead_time_days FROM scm.supply_policy

question: 생활용품 카테고리 품목은 몇 개야?
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scm.product WHERE category = '생활용품'

question: 현재 입고 예정 수량이 가장 많은 거점은 어디야?
goldenSql: SELECT l.name FROM scm.inventory_daily i JOIN scm.location l ON l.location_id = i.location_id WHERE i.snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08' GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY SUM(i.in_transit) DESC, l.name LIMIT 1

question: SKU-021의 거점별 현재고를 보여줘
goldenSql: SELECT on_hand FROM scm.inventory_daily WHERE sku = 'SKU-021' AND snap_date = DATE '2026-11-08'

question: 저번 그 품목 판매 추이 어때?
